title: About me | Thuy An Portfolio
description: About Thuy An – illustrator and UI designer from Vietnam based in Fukuoka: employment overview, work experience and design skills.
heading: About me

sections.title: [Employment Overview]
sections.body:
・While still a university student, I worked as an intern on 2D graphic design such as flyers and posters.
・I designed and sold products of my own, including New Year money envelopes and postcards.
・As a freelancer I took commissions from various publishers in Vietnam, working both digitally and by hand.
・On a commission from a Chinese manga publisher, I set up a studio with friends as a startup and handled manga colouring.
・At CaeruxLab I work as an illustrator and on UI/UX design.

sections.title: [Work Experience]
sections.body:
・Until June 2018
Intern at a design company in Vietnam
Client: a Vietnamese company
Work: 2D graphic design such as flyers and posters
Team size: on my own
Software: Photoshop, Illustrator

・October 2018 - April 2019
A startup founded with friends on a commission from a Chinese company
Client: a Chinese manga company
Work: from the name (storyboard) through inked pages and colouring to the finished artwork
Team size: 6
As the leader I assigned the tasks, managed quality and drew as well
Software: Photoshop, Illustrator

・April 2019 - March 2022
Freelancing remotely while attending a Japanese language school
Client: publishers in Vietnam
Work: turning manuscripts into picture books
Team size: on my own
Software: Photoshop, Illustrator

・March 2022 - December 2024
Designer at CaeruxLab
Work: UI/UX design and mini-game design
Software: Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe XD, Figma

・January 2025 - present
Working as a designer under a contract with Caerux Inc. (head office)
Work: UI/UX design and illustration
Software: Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe XD, Figma
